launch_local_experiment_job: launch a local subprocess experiment job with a shell command and capture stdout and stderr logs
check_local_job_status: check the status of a running local job and return SUCCEEDED FAILED or RUNNING
collect_local_evidence: collect metrics evidence from local job logs including stdout stderr and exit code
extract_traceback_from_text: extract a Python traceback block from arbitrary text output for error diagnosis
summarize_error_from_text: summarize errors from text output by finding the most relevant error or exception line
